intro: Sunny, generous Mediterranean cooking: olive oil on everything, grilled meats, feta, lemon and oregano, eaten slowly at a taverna.
flavours: Olive oil, lemon, oregano, feta, yoghurt, dill

dishes.name: Moussaka
dishes.what: Layers of aubergine and spiced minced lamb under a thick béchamel top.

dishes.name: Souvlaki
dishes.what: Small chunks of grilled pork or chicken on a skewer, often wrapped in pitta.

dishes.name: Gyros
dishes.what: Meat roasted on a vertical spit, shaved into pitta with tomato, onion, fries and tzatziki.

dishes.name: Greek salad
dishes.what: Village salad with a slab of feta on top and no lettuce.

dishes.name: Spanakopita
dishes.what: Crisp filo pie filled with spinach and feta.

dishes.name: Tzatziki
dishes.what: Cool garlicky yoghurt dip with grated cucumber.

dishes.name: Pastitsio
dishes.what: Greek baked pasta: tubes of pasta, spiced meat sauce and béchamel.

dishes.name: Loukoumades
dishes.what: Little fried dough balls soaked in honey and dusted with cinnamon.
